info.title: AMLOK API
info.description: API reference for AMLOK 1.4.2, with example requests and responses. Configure your institution-issued environment URL before making requests.

servers.description: Set the server URL to your institution-issued AMLOK environment URL.

get.description:
List authorized connection records.

Required scope: `connections:read`. Source, module, country, consent and contracted permissions determine population.

parameters.name: X-Request-ID
parameters.description: Optional caller correlation ID; the response includes AMLOK request_id.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Default 100, maximum 200.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque AMLOK cursor. Preserve the original filters.

parameters.name: subject_id
parameters.description: Filter to one authorized business or person where applicable.

parameters.name: updated_from
parameters.description: Inclusive normalized update time.

parameters.name: updated_to
parameters.description: Exclusive normalized update time.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by this resource status.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated top-level field names. Required identity and metadata always remain. Selected objects are complete; nested paths and wildcards are unsupported. Unknown fields return 400 validation_error.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated optional expansions: provenance, missing_fields. No unrestricted graph traversal.

parameters.name: snapshot_id
parameters.description: Optional synchronization-checkpoint ID. Freezes this collection at the checkpoint boundary; cursor binds the snapshot. Unsupported or expired snapshots return 410.

x-codeSamples.label: cURL
x-codeSamples.source:
curl --request GET --fail-with-body --max-time 30 \
  "${AMLOK_API_BASE_URL}/v1/connections?limit=100&cursor=cur_example&subject_id=biz_example&fields=id%2Cobject%2Cupdated_at&include=provenance" \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer ${AMLOK_API_KEY}" \
  --header "Accept: application/json"

import os
import requests

base_url = os.environ["AMLOK_API_BASE_URL"].rstrip("/")
headers = {'Accept': 'application/json'}
headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + os.environ["AMLOK_API_KEY"]

response = requests.request(
    "GET", base_url + "/v1/connections?limit=100&cursor=cur_example&subject_id=biz_example&fields=id%2Cobject%2Cupdated_at&include=provenance",
    headers=headers, timeout=30, allow_redirects=False,
)
response.raise_for_status()
print(response.json())

post.description:
Start an authorized source-connection flow.

Required scope: `connections:write`. Return a short-lived authorization action; no provider secret in response. Once account cancellation is submitted, processing and usage deductions stop immediately. Reject new operational commands with 409 invalid_state; pending work is cancelled without another debit. Read-only reporting remains available until workspace deletion.

parameters.name: X-Request-ID
parameters.description: Optional caller correlation ID; the response includes AMLOK request_id.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Reuse for retries of the same intended command and identical payload. Retention: 24 hours.

x-codeSamples.label: cURL
x-codeSamples.source:
curl --request POST --fail-with-body --max-time 30 \
  "${AMLOK_API_BASE_URL}/v1/connections" \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer ${AMLOK_API_KEY}" \
  --header "Accept: application/json" \
  --header 'Idempotency-Key: idem_example_1001' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
  "subject_id": "biz_example",
  "provider_id": "BANK-02",
  "products": [
    "transactions"
  ],
  "consent_id": "con_example",
  "redirect_uri": "https://client.example.com/connected"
}'

import os
import requests

base_url = os.environ["AMLOK_API_BASE_URL"].rstrip("/")
headers = {'Accept': 'application/json',
 'Idempotency-Key': 'idem_example_1001',
 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + os.environ["AMLOK_API_KEY"]

response = requests.request(
    "POST", base_url + "/v1/connections",
    headers=headers, timeout=30, allow_redirects=False,
    json={'subject_id': 'biz_example',
 'provider_id': 'BANK-02',
 'products': ['transactions'],
 'consent_id': 'con_example',
 'redirect_uri': 'https://client.example.com/connected'},
)
response.raise_for_status()
print(response.json())

post.description:
Run a lien search with explicit jurisdiction and debtor scope.

Required scope: `liens:search`. Adapter resolves provider business/person context; no filing or perfection action. Once account cancellation is submitted, processing and usage deductions stop immediately. Reject new operational commands with 409 invalid_state; pending work is cancelled without another debit. Read-only reporting remains available until workspace deletion. This is a stage of an authorized Insights or Signal workflow. processing_context is required; unrelated, completed, unpaid, cancelled or unentitled contexts return 409 invalid_state. It creates no separate AMLOK charge. The orchestrator deduplicates equivalent stage work within the parent.

parameters.description: Optional caller correlation ID; the response includes AMLOK request_id.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Reuse for retries of the same intended command and identical payload. Retention: 24 hours.

}'

post.description:
Configure ongoing monitoring against a baseline.

Required scope: `monitoring:write`. Refresh frequency remains subject to provider and consent limits. Once account cancellation is submitted, processing and usage deductions stop immediately. Reject new operational commands with 409 invalid_state; pending work is cancelled without another debit. Read-only reporting remains available until workspace deletion. Discover approved baselines through GET /v1/monitoring-baselines. Supply its snapshot_id as baseline_snapshot_id; it must be ready and belong to this subject and workspace. Multiple monitors do not create multiple Signal account-month charges. Signal charges the full agreed monthly rate once per borrower/business/workspace at 00:00 UTC on the first day of the month, before monitoring proceeds. First activation during a month charges the full monthly rate immediately, without proration; the next charge is at the next month boundary. Repeated monitor creation, pauses, resumes, checks and reassessments do not add charges in an already paid period. Insufficient credits block monitoring without a debit or debt; funding resumes only the current period after its single successful charge, without charging missed inactive months. User-paused monitoring remains paused until the user resumes it. Account cancellation stops processing and all further deductions immediately.

post.description:
Run a coordinated risk workflow.

Required scope: `workflows:execute`. AMLOK returns evidence and assessment results. The institution performs all borrower outreach and intervention in its own systems. Once account cancellation is submitted, processing and usage deductions stop immediately. Reject new operational commands with 409 invalid_state; pending work is cancelled without another debit. Read-only reporting remains available until workspace deletion. Billable work requires available credits covering its cost; otherwise return 402 insufficient_credits before accepting work, with no debit. A separately requested full underwriting uses Insights. Signal change-driven reassessment is included in Signal and does not create an additional Insights charge. A root underwrite request is a full Insights underwriting and requires application_id and input_manifest_id. Other workflow types require processing_context and are included stages. Signal reassessment is a Signal child run, never a separately billed root underwrite. Workload checks reject known over-limit inputs with 422 workload_limit_exceeded. If discovery reveals more records later, pause as blocked_by_limit before processing beyond the limit. No automatic tier upgrade occurs. Available credits are checked at acceptance and again atomically with output publication and the one usage debit at successful completion. No credits are reserved. If funds were spent by concurrent work, keep the run waiting_for_credits and withhold its final output; resume without duplicate processing when funded. Cancelled runs never publish or charge. Each evidence manifest is immutable. While an unfinished run waits for required evidence, accepted evidence can create a successor manifest; retain initial_input_manifest_id, update input_manifest_id and record_version, and emit an audit event identifying both manifests. The final snapshot and usage link to the final manifest. This continuation keeps the same run and single charge.

A cursor expired beyond that time returns 410 cursor_expired and requires a new checkpoint plus a fresh bootstrap. Filters and workspace binding cannot change mid-stream. Deleted resources emit tombstones. Billing resources use billing snapshots and billing events, not this normalized-data feed.

post.description: Create a read-only synchronization boundary. This does not synchronize a provider, process a product or spend credits. Read each requested collection with snapshot_id equal to this checkpoint ID, then consume /v1/changes from resume_cursor. Both refer to the same as_of boundary, preventing a bootstrap gap. Snapshots and resume cursors remain valid until their explicit expires_at. Reject unentitled types. Workspace deletion revokes checkpoints. Checkpoint creation remains available while read-only reporting access remains active.
